title: Georgia local officials: current boards and term history
description: Elected county commissions and city councils: who holds each seat now (officials), and every recorded holder of every seat, one row per person per term (officials-history). History is not backfilled: it starts at historyStartsAt.
updateCadence: Twice weekly (Mondays and Thursdays), from a hand-maintained roster; a person confirms every row against its `source`.
source: county and city government websites, agendas and minutes, and Secretary of State election results, confirmed by a person
